answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit stake. Exit starts a six-epoch cooldown: the stake stays locked, cannot move to a new identity, and stays slashable throughout. The kth fake needs a 60-credit lock frozen six epochs, so 1,000 fakes tie up 60,000 credits, no reuse, no shortcut. A river ledger lists each exit's cooldown end, a whisper alert flags re-entry, and a velvet check blocks re-entry until the cooldown passes. An honest agent locks one stake, waits one cooldown, and leaves clean. Rented cooldown slots fail: the lock is key-bound, the wait cannot shorten, and a slash burns the rented stake.
